about: The first cut of E54 (the file split, wave 3): scripts/sheet.mjs into a facade and eight files, by whole top-level
declarations. Read by tools/e54/split.mjs, which refuses when a listed declaration is missing, is of another kind, or a
top-level declaration of the source is listed nowhere. `kind` is the declaration's kind at 421f2395 (origin/main,
13.11.2026); the groups are the E54 plan's (docs/dev/E54/PLAN.md on the prep-54 line, section 3.1), read by name.
facadeNote: E54 (the file split, wave 3): this file is the sheet family's facade. It keeps the registration
(`registerSheetTweaks`), the step table (`SHEET_STEPS`, `runSheetSteps`) and the render hook (`onRenderCharacterSheet`);
every other name it exported is re-exported from the family's files - sheet-mode, sheet-item, sheet-repaint, sheet-fit,
sheet-header, sheet-sidebar, sheet-inventory and sheet-actions - which never import it.

header: The sheet's mode (E54, the sheet's family): what the person looking at a character sheet may see and do -
`sheetMode`, built once a render; the render's mode kept for the row builders (`RENDER_MODES`, `modeOf`); the row's and
the header's gates (`rowGate`, `headerGate`); and the sheets open for an actor (`sheetsFor`). A leaf of the family: every
other sheet file reads it, and it reads none of them.
The item sheet (E54, the sheet's family): Daggerheart's item sheet cut to what an item is - its tabs, editors and
heading dropped, its kind labelled, name and description locked - with the wear line (`wearMarkup`), a Truth Bullet's
badges (`bulletBadges`, `classSafe`) and the tab dropper the character sheet shares (`dropTab`).
The flicker's repair (E54, the sheet's family): `renderPlan` and `installRenderPlan`, which repaint a sheet in
place for a resource write instead of rendering it, and `repaintInPlace` with the priced tiles, the Calls and the
Monocub tiles it refreshes, inside `settle`.
How the sheet fits its window (E54, the sheet's family): the Loadout tab left, a tab's scroll kept, the action
tiles' fit (`fitActionTiles`, `fitTileText`, `watchTileFit`, `LONGEST_TILE_WORD`, `softWrap`) and the sheet's height
held and grown for the Calls (`holdActionsTab`, `growForCalls`).
The sheet's header (E54, the sheet's family): the trait frames and glyphs, the action bar with the time of day
and Hope's flash, the starting resources' button, Advancement, the death mark and the GM's controls, giving and taking
items, the Ultimate and its public helpers (`getUltimate`, `setUltimate`, `findDuplicateUltimates`).
The sheet's sidebar and its other tabs (E54, the sheet's family): the sidebar tidied, the reserves
(`paintReserves`, `writeReserve`, `paintPartyReserves`), the equipped tools, an empty experience, the known passages and
the step through one, the safeword and the biography (`tidyBiography`, `saveBiography`).
The inventory (E54, the sheet's family): the system's create buttons removed, the groups the player chose,
the rows and their buttons (use, equip, discard, stash, present, hand over; `guardRow` among them), the open stashes and
the Truth Bullets' groups, order and folds (`bulletGroups`).
The action panel (E54, the sheet's family): the rules panel that replaces the Effects tab, `injectActionPanel`
with the Monocub and Calls panels and their buttons, whether Tamper has anything to work on (`forgetTamper`), and the
tile itself with its price (`actionButton`).

textMapNamedWhy: tools/text-map.mjs reaches a unit of another file one hop from an entry point: the sheet's steps reached
sheetMode in the same file, and through it trial-floor.mjs presentRefusal's two keys (DRPG.Trial.presentNobody, presentOnly);
from sheet-mode.mjs that is two hops. Named in the sheet's row, sheetMode is an entry point and the keys stay the sheet's
(measured 13.11.2026: without it 2 keys unassigned, 5804 of 6162 assigned against main's 5806).

repoint.about: tools/e54/repoint.mjs's part: what it rewrites besides its generic forms (its header). `sites` are readings measured on the split tree - a list of files an expression reads, a count per file - found by their text exactly once; `patches` are corrections to a reader the split exposed, each with its why. Which file holds a name is never written here: it is `targets` and `keep` above.

sites.why: the files whose code (comments stripped) builds a nominative grant key by template; the test's `reading` lists them sorted
the census of `type === "character"` per file, comments left in, as the test counts it
the census document's row for sheet.mjs, one row per file it stands in now, at its lines there

patches.why: R22's binding reader took a destructuring only before `=`; the facade's `runSheetSteps` binds `run` in a for-of alone, which the whole file had also bound elsewhere

patches.find: must(src.length > 20000, `${file} read nothing - this test would read nothing`);
patches.replace: must(src.length > 2000, `${file} read nothing - this test would read nothing`);
patches.why: the guard is against an empty read: the sheet's family is read file by file now, and its smallest file (sheet-mode.mjs, about 9700 characters, strings blanked) is under the 20000 the whole sheet.mjs cleared
